name: Maglód (Hungary)
description: Three horizontal stripes of dark blue, yellow and dark blue in the ratio 1:1:1, charged at the centre with the town arms of Maglód: a red and blue shield with reeds, a church and waves, within a green wreath.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
